IGUI_MQ_Admin_LayoutError: This page could not be drawn. See console.txt.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NoReply: The server did not answer within 10 seconds. Press Reload to check the result.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_TooBig: Too many changes at once (over 32 KB). Apply them in smaller batches.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Applied: Applied (change #%1). You can undo it on the History tab.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_KeepUnlocked: Achievements already unlocked are not taken back.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrRange: Must be from %1 to %2 (whole numbers where counts are asked).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrIncreasing: Each threshold must be higher than the tier before.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrPtsCount: Give as many point values as thresholds.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrMinMax: The minimum cannot be larger than the maximum.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrMilestones: Milestone days must increase from one to the next.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrDate: Write dates as YYYY-MM-DD; the end cannot be before the start.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ErrPast: The end date has passed. Pick today or a later date.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HistoryNote: The last 20 changes are kept. Undo writes the old values back and is recorded as a change too.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileNote: config.json in %1 on the server holds the panel settings that differ from the defaults (events and the season length are not in it). Edit and save it: the change applies within about a minute and is recorded in this history. Applying or undoing in the panel rewrites the file. A file with an error is not applied and the current settings stay. defaults.json in the same folder lists every default value; status.json holds the result of the last read.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileOk: Last synced %1: config.json matches the settings in effect.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileBad: config.json (read %1) has an error and was not applied; the current settings stay. %2
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileIo: Could not read or write config.json (%1, %2). Check the folder's permissions and free disk space on the server.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_DiffNote: Quick difficulty changes thresholds and quest targets only, not points.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_BatchHelp: Batch edits change every achievement in the category shown and go into the pending changes; press Apply below to review them and confirm. To change only a few, use Edit on their rows.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Skipped: %1 achievements were left unchanged (top threshold over 1,000,000,000 or already 10 tiers).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_InDraft: Added to the pending changes. Press Apply below to review and confirm.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_InDraftWhat: %1: added to the pending changes. Press Apply below to review and confirm.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NewAch: + New achievement from an existing stat
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NewAchHelp: Pick an existing stat, then enter a name, thresholds and points (comma separated, the same count, up to 10).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_PoolHelp: Each row: on, quest, target range (min - max) and points. Pick a theme to switch or scale its whole group.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_F_streak_need: Quests per day for a streak day
IGUI_MQ_Admin_F_quests_playerList: Players see each theme's quests on Settings
IGUI_MQ_Admin_SeasonPreviewBody: This season will settle at %1; season %2 starts %3.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_SeasonLengthNote: 7 to 180 days. A new length applies to this season right away; the new settlement must be at least 24 hours away.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_SeasonApplied: Season length is now %1 days; it settles at %2.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReviewNone: The list appears here when the season ends.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReviewNote: Accounts with anomalies are only marked, not excluded. Excluding needs a reason. Without action, rewards are paid from the frozen list 24 hours after the freeze. Paying asks once more.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ExcludeAsk: Exclude %1 (%2 points) from this season's rewards?
IGUI_MQ_Admin_PayAsk: Pay season %1 rewards to %2 accounts (%3 excluded)? This cannot be undone.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_RewardsNote: Reward points only go to the balance and do not count toward rank.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_NoEconomy: The economy mod is not installed or not ready, so points cannot be exchanged.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_over_cap_Body: The economy mod gives this mod a daily limit of %1 survivor coins, shared by all players on the server. Once it is used up, later exchanges wait in the queue and are paid after the next daily reset. Raise this mod's Daily issue cap on the economy admin's Integration sources page, or lower the rate.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_cap_zero_Body: The economy mod gives this mod a daily limit of 0 (shared by all players), so every exchange waits in the queue. Set this mod's Daily issue cap on the economy admin's Integration sources page.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_disabled_Body: The economy mod has turned this mod off as a source, so exchanges wait in the queue. Turn it back on on the economy admin's Integration sources page.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_Warn_unknown_Body: The economy mod is installed but the daily limit it gives this mod (shared by all players) could not be read. Check this mod's Daily issue cap on the economy admin's Integration sources page (the default 0 sends every exchange to the queue).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ExEcUsed: Paid out by the economy today (all players)
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EcOpen: Change the limit in Economy Administration
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EcOpenDenied: You do not have access to Economy Administration. Ask an economy admin to change the limit.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EcOpenFailed: Economy Administration cannot be opened right now.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EventsNote: Multiplies daily and weekly quest points only. At most 3 at a time.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EventRemoveAsk: Remove the event "%1"? Its multiplier stops right away. This cannot be undone.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_EventsMax: 3 events are already running or scheduled. Remove one to add another.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HideAsk: Account %1: remove from every leaderboard (1 account). The data is kept.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_UnhideAsk: Put account %1 back on the leaderboards?
IGUI_MQ_Admin_DangerNote: Revoking and removal are recorded with your name and the reason.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_AnomNote: Each stat has a per-minute limit (120 zombie kills by default, for example). Going over it within one minute records one entry: the excess is not counted, so it does not advance quests or achievements. Normal play rarely gets there; mass farming or scripts can. The season settlement list marks these accounts but does not exclude them. "View" shows that account's points and achievements above, where you can revoke achievements or remove it from the leaderboards.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_BalanceNote: Daily quests: the last 7 days; weekly quests: the last week that ended. Completion leaves out swapped quests; time to finish is the median from given to done. Quests given %1+ times (swaps not counted) with completion under 30%% or over 90%% get a target suggestion below. Apply suggestions lists every change before you confirm.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportNote: Counted at %1, refreshed every 5 minutes. Totals only, no individual players.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportSaved: Saved to %1 (one file per day; exporting again the same day overwrites it).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportWeekLine: Weekly quest completion %1   Quests swapped %2   Players on a 7+ day streak: %3
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportIssued: Given out in the last %1 days: %2 points
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportEcon: Exchanged for coins: %1 (players: %2)   Unspent points: %3   Top 10%% of players hold %4
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportAchvNote: Players active in the last %1 days: %2. Tiers unlocked per player on average: %3 (%4 in all).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportAchvEmpty: No active player in this period has unlocked an achievement yet.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ReportNoneHidden: Unlocked by no one: %1 (%2; plus %3 hidden)
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FewSamples: Too few samples (given fewer than %1 times)
IGUI_MQ_Admin_BalanceNone: No quests were given in the last 7 days. Data appears once players receive daily or weekly quests.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_TownsNote: Towns count for the explore achievements. Turn a built-in town off to stop counting visits there.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_BasicNote: Steps 1-5 set the common options. Difficulty asks you to confirm; for the rest, press Apply below.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ImmediateNote: Buttons in this section take effect at once, skip the Apply review below, and cannot be undone from History.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_AchEnabledNote: When off, players no longer see it on the achievements page and cannot unlock it.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_CeilNote: How much each stat can count in one minute; anything over is not counted and records an anomaly. Press Apply below to save.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_FileOnly: Only config.json changes these: leaderboards (boards), community goal rotation (goal.rotation), newcomer title and days (newbie.title, newbie.days).
IGUI_MQ_Admin_DiscardAsk: Discard %1 pending changes? This cannot be undone.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_DiscardAsk1: Discard %1 pending change? This cannot be undone.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_ConfirmClosed: The Apply changes? view was closed; nothing was applied.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeNote: At a random spot below, a horde appears when a player comes within 50 tiles; clearing it in time pays points. Inside the daily window the server rolls once an hour.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeNowNote: Start one now skips the roll and starts a horde at once.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeCancelAsk: Cancel the horde at %1? Players who saw the warning are told it is cancelled.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeStopAsk: Stop the horde at %1? It ends as failed, nobody gets points, and the zombies it spawned are removed.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeNowAsk: Start a horde now at a random spot? It uses the applied settings; changes still waiting for Apply are not used. Players are told at once.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeAutoOff: Automatic hordes are off. Start one now still works.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeTodayDone: Today %1 / %2 hordes, no more rolls today
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeSpotsNote: Stand where a horde should appear and add your position. Spots are settings: press Apply below to save them.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeSpotsNone: No spots yet: automatic hordes and Start one now need at least one.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeKindsNote: Kind weights: only kinds above 0 can appear, and the warning names only those, never the count.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeKindsNone: No kinds yet: every zombie is a regular one.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeKindsAll: Every kind is in the list.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordePoolNote: Reward pool = zombies spawned x points per zombie.
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeSplit_each: Full pool to everyone with a kill
IGUI_MQ_Admin_HordeErrClock: Write the time as HH:MM, 00:00 to 23:59.

IGUI_MQ_UI_AnonNote: Your rank still counts; other players see "Anonymous survivor" instead of your name and title, but admins can still see who you are. This only applies to this mod's leaderboards and notices; your title over your head and in chat still shows.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardEmptyBody: Finish daily quests or unlock achievements to show up here.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardEmptySeason: Nobody is on this season's board yet
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardEmptyTotal: Nobody is on this board yet
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardErrorBody: The server did not answer within 5 seconds. Press Refresh to try again.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardNotRanked: You are not on this board yet.
IGUI_MQ_UI_BoardTotalOnly: This board only has an all-time ranking.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExAfter: Balance after: %1 points. Ranks use points earned, so exchanging does not change your rank.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExDayLimit: You can only exchange %1 more points today.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExLeft: You can still exchange %1 points today
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExNoPoints: You do not have enough points.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExNoReplyBody: Press Ask again to get the result. Asking again never exchanges twice.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExOff: Exchanging is turned off right now.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExQueuedBody: The economy's allowance for today is used up; it will be paid automatically.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExQueuedBodyN: Today's exchange allowance is used up. Your %1 points are held and paid automatically after the next reset.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExQueuedNote: %1 points are queued: the economy's allowance for today is used up; they will be paid automatically.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExRateNote: Survivor coins per point: %1 (set by the server).
IGUI_MQ_UI_ExRefusedBody: Your economy account cannot receive coins right now; %1 points were returned. Please contact an admin.
IGUI_MQ_UI_GoalRule: When the goal is reached, everyone who contributed %1 or more gets +%2 points.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ModOptionsNote: The toolbar entry, server-wide unlock notices, the tracker panel and titles above heads and in chat can be turned off in the game's Options > MODS > Quests & Achievements.
IGUI_MQ_UI_NeedFramework: Quests & Achievements needs a newer Minidoracat UI framework.
IGUI_MQ_UI_NewbieStep_4: Leave your starting town carrying a weapon
IGUI_MQ_UI_NoQuests: No quests yet. They appear at the next reset.
IGUI_MQ_UI_NoState: The server has not sent your quest data yet.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ParticipationLeft: %1 more points for the participation reward
IGUI_MQ_UI_PointsNote: Your spendable points; exchanges take from here. Leaderboards use points earned this season.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ImportNote: From before this mod was added, only your current character's zombie kills, days survived in this life and skill levels were imported; every other stat counts from the day it was added.
IGUI_MQ_UI_PointsNoteEx: Exchanging only spends the balance; ranks use points earned.
IGUI_MQ_UI_PrefsRule: Each day 2 quests come from the themes you pick and 1 from all themes. Each card shows its points; Tailoring, Animal Care, Fishing & Trapping and Foraging quests pay more by default.
IGUI_MQ_UI_PrefsWhen: If today's quests were already made, the change applies from the next reset.
IGUI_MQ_UI_QuestListAdminOnly: Only admins can see this. To show it to players, turn it on in Admin > Quests.
IGUI_MQ_UI_RecordsError: Could not load your records (no answer within 5 seconds).
IGUI_MQ_UI_RecordsNote: "This life" resets when the character dies; "All-time" is kept across characters and is what achievements count.
IGUI_MQ_UI_RewardNote: Season reward points go to your balance only and do not count toward ranks. The top 10 come from the overall board.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SeasonPayingBody: Rewards arrive on their own; watch your notifications.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SeasonReviewBody: Ranks are frozen while rewards are confirmed. They are paid within 24 hours; you do not need to do anything.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SharedNote: The server-wide quest is one per day, the same for everyone, and cannot be swapped.
IGUI_MQ_UI_StreakRule: A day counts when you finish %1 of the 4 quests. Grace days per week: %2. A missed day uses one instead of breaking your streak.
IGUI_MQ_UI_SwapAsk: Swap "%1"? Your progress (%2) will be lost and cannot be restored.
IGUI_MQ_UI_ToastAchvManyBody: %1. Open Quests & Achievements to see them all.
IGUI_MQ_Horde_HudWait: Starts when someone is within 50 tiles of %1, %2
IGUI_MQ_Horde_WaitBody: When someone gets within 50 tiles of %1, %2, the horde appears and the timer starts.

IGUI_MQ_Horde_ActiveBody_each: Cleared %1/%2 · everyone with a kill gets %3 points
IGUI_MQ_Horde_SpawnBody_share: Clear it within %1 min. %2 points, split by kills.
IGUI_MQ_Horde_SpawnBody_each: Clear it within %1 min. Everyone with a kill gets %2 points.
IGUI_MQ_Horde_WinBody_share: Participants: %1. They split %2 points by kills.

IGUI_MQ_Horde_WinMine_each: You cleared %1. The points count for the season and can be exchanged.
IGUI_MQ_Horde_WinOthers: %1 of %2 cleared. Only players with a kill get points.

IGUI_MQ_Horde_Why_timeLeft: Time ran out; the %1 left were removed.
